item.title: 📆 Top News Today Keeping the pace: we have established control over Olkhovatka in Kharkov region.
item.description: 📆 Top News Today ↗️ Keeping the pace: we have established control over Olkhovatka in Kharkov region. 🔥 Ports in fire, vessels at bottom: we launched group strikes against logistics centres and ports of Ukraine, as well as vessels used in the interests of the AFU. 🎯 Gerans' great accuracy: hit the Yagodin international motor vehicle checkpoint and an AFU rolling stock in Volyn region. 💥 Drones’ lair burnt out: the Tsentr Group's drone pilots destroyed enemy's camouflaged UAV command post in Dobropolye direction. ▫️ Clipping Polish Krab's claws: the Yuzhnaya Group's servicemen hit a Polish-made Krab self-propelled artillery system position. ✈️ Tu-95ms in air : the long-range bombers of the Russian Aerospace Forces conducted a planned flight over the neutral waters of the Barents and Norwegian seas. ▫️ Blazing swarm in action: as part of drills, flamethrower operators held exercises on using RPO-A Shmel rocket infantry flamethrowers. #TopNews 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ During the day, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued to carry out strikes against Ukrainian ports and vessels used in the interests of the AFU.
item.description: ❗️ During the day, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued to carry out strikes against Ukrainian ports and vessels used in the interests of the AFU. As a result of UAV strikes, the following targets were hit: ▪️ in the port of Chernomorsk, a Ro‑Ro ship that delivered cargo to support the Armed Forces of Ukraine; ▪️ in the port of Izmail, a tanker that delivered fuel and lubricants for the AFU. ▪️ in the Yuzhny port, a rolling stock used to support the AFU at the moment of cargo loading. ▪️ In addition, strikes against railway infrastructure facilities in the western regions of Ukraine which are used to transport military cargo from European countries have been continued. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ✈️ Tu-95ms in air Tu-95ms long-range bombers of the Russian Aerospace Forces conducted a planned flight
item.description: Tu-95ms in air ✈️ Tu-95ms long-range bombers of the Russian Aerospace Forces conducted a planned flight over the neutral waters of the Barents and Norwegian seas. ⏱️ The flight took about 5 hours. ▫️ Su-33 fighter jet crews of the Russian Navy escorted the bombers. At certain stages of the route, the long-range bombers were escorted by fighter jets from foreign countries. Crews of long-range aviation regularly conduct flights over the neutral waters of the Arctic, North Atlantic, Pacific Ocean, Black and Baltic seas. All flights of Russian Aerospace Forces aircraft are carried out in strict compliance with international rules on the use of airspace. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.content:encoded:

🎖
🎖
by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation
as of 15 September 2026
Part 2 (
👉
see
Part 1
)
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Russian troops inflicted fire damage on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, a motorised infantry brigade, an airmobile brigade, a mountain assault brigade of the AFU, and a territorial defence brigade close to Druzhkovka, Orekhovatka, Kondratovka, Vasilevskaya Pustosh, Slavyansk, Starodubovka, Kramatorsk, and Nikolayevka in the Donetsk People's Republic.
▪️
The enemy lost up to 165 troops, one Canadian-made Senator armoured fighting vehicle, 17 motor vehicles, and one British-made 155-mm Braveheart self-propelled artillery system.
📍
The Tsentr Group's units improved the tactical situation.
The Group's units inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, an assault regiment of the AFU, a marine brigade, and two national guard brigades near Novovodyanoye, Dobropolye, Gulevo, Maryevka, Andreyevka, Belozerskoye (Donetsk People's Republic), and Ivanovka (Dnepropetrovsk region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 345 troops, four armoured fighting vehicles, 12 motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station.
↗️
The Vostok Group's units advanced to the depth of the enemy's defence.
Russian troops inflicted damage on manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade, an air assault brigade, an assault regiment of the AFU, and a marine brigade near Ivanovka, Orestopol (Dnepropetrovsk region), Samoylovka, Omelnik, Vasilevskoye, and Obshcheye (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 285 troops, 13 motor vehicles, and a counter-fire station.
💥
Units of the Dnepr Group of Forces inflicted losses on
manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade of the AFU and two territorial defence brigades near Orekhov, Malokaterinovka, Yulyevka, Yurkovka, and Grigorovka (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
Up to 35 troops, 15 motor vehicles, and three electronic warfare stations of the enemy were neutralised.
✈️
Operational-tactical aviation, attack drones, missile troops, and artillery of the Russian Groups of Forces inflicted damage on
Ukrainian energy and transport infrastructure used by the AFU, storage and assembly facilities of unmanned aerial vehicles, temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries in 139 areas.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
six guided aerial bombs and 589 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles.
📊
In total,
since the beginning of the special military operation, the enemy
has lost:
▫️
674
aircraft,
▫️
284
helicopters,
▫️
236,589
unmanned aerial vehicles,
▫️
672
anti-aircraft missile systems,
▫️
30,930
tanks and other armoured fighting vehicles,
▫️
1,777
MLRS combat vehicles,
▫️
36,463
field artillery guns and mortars,
▫️
71,960
special military vehicles.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
